title: Effects of ELDOA on Hamstring Tightness
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to find the effects of ELDOA in increasing hamstring length in patients with nonspecific low back pain.This research will bring awareness about the concept of ELDOA exercises among clinicians and people to understand its benefits for treating back pain issues. Further, it will provide an important addition to the evidence-based treatment intervention of ELDOA
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Low back pain for at least 2 months.
* A passive SLR angle of 70° or less.
* Both genders.
* 25-40 years age.
* Pain \> 3 on NPRS

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any fracture of spine or lower limb.
* No neurological signs.
* Malignancy, infection, trauma or any bony deformity.
* Surgery of spine or lower limb.
